List Bank of Japan API databases

Source: R/databases.R
boj_databases.Rd

Returns the package's static transcription of the 50 database identifiers declared by the official Bank of Japan Time-Series Data Search API manual, revision 2026-02-18. The registry is local and deterministic: calling this function does not contact the Bank of Japan, use the request cache, or write files. The manual URL, retrieval date, SHA-256, and byte count are retained in provenance so callers can audit which declared registry was packaged.

Usage

boj_databases()

Value

A 50-row data frame in the fixed manual order with character columns db (database identifier), category_en (English category), name_en (English database name), name_jp (Japanese database name), and manual_revision (the scalar value "2026-02-18" in every row). The data frame has a readboj_provenance attribute containing source, source_url, source_sha256, source_bytes, source_retrieved_at, manual_revision, complete_declared_surface (TRUE), and database_count (50L).

Details

The registry describes API database identities and bilingual labels; it is not a download of observations and does not assert that every database is currently available. The labels and database facts follow the official manual. The package also retains a third-party notice for registry/API parsing design informed by bojapi; that notice does not make its author a readboj author or change this package's MIT license.

See also

boj_metadata(), search_boj_series(), build_boj_catalogue_snapshot(), boj_provenance()

Examples

databases <- boj_databases()
stopifnot(nrow(databases) == 50L)
stopifnot(identical(databases$db[[1L]], "IR01"))
stopifnot(identical(unique(databases$manual_revision), "2026-02-18"))
